description: Election Commission - B. S. Jahan was selected as the member of the Kalmunai Municipal Council - A. H. Anver was selected as the member of the Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Kalmunai Municipal Council and Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of selected members to fill vacancies that occurred when previous members ceased to be party members. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and candidate nominations/registrations for local government positions.
